title: Occupancy Network-Guided Autonomous Robotic Partial Nephrectomy
summary: Autonomous soft-tissue cancer surgery has been limited to interventions on organ surfaces, because current systems cannot perceive and adapt to anatomy once it deforms or is cut. We introduce the first vision-guided autonomous system capable of performing complete tumor resections for partial nephrectomy. Our system integrates conditional occupancy networks, trained entirely in a physics-based simulation, that infer full 3-D anatomy (tumor, margin tissue, and kidney) from single-view partial point clouds. These occupancy networks maintain intraoperative tracking even as tissue is cut and deformed, enabling adaptive planning and execution. The surgical platform combines a depth camera for capturing surface point clouds, dual robotic arms for electrosurgical cutting and vacuum-based tissue manipulation, and an autonomous control strategy for tumor resection. In patient-derived hydrogel phantoms under an open partial nephrectomy setting, the robot performed eight consecutive autonomous tumor resections comprising 77 electrosurgical cuts, with all cuts achieving negative surgical margins and 1.61 $\pm$ 0.48 mm mean absolute margin error. This work demonstrates, for the first time, a foundation for supervised autonomous closed-loop, imaging-driven, margin-negative tumor removal in phantoms.
tldr: This paper presents the first vision-guided autonomous system for partial nephrectomy, using simulation-trained conditional occupancy networks to infer and track full 3D anatomy from partial point clouds despite cutting and deformation. In hydrogel phantoms, the robot performed eight autonomous tumor resections with 77 electrosurgical cuts, all achieving negative margins and low mean margin error.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了首个视觉引导的自主部分肾切除术系统，利用在仿真中训练的条件占据网络，从局部点云推断并追踪完整3D解剖结构，即使组织被切割和变形也能适应。在患者来源的水凝胶体模中，机器人完成了8次自主肿瘤切除、共77次电外科切割，所有切缘均为阴性，平均切缘误差为1.61±0.48毫米。
summary_zh: 自主软组织癌症手术一直局限于器官表面的干预，因为当前系统无法在解剖结构变形或被切割后感知并适应其变化。我们引入了首个视觉引导的自主系统，能够完成部分肾切除术中的完整肿瘤切除。我们的系统集成了完全在基于物理的仿真中训练的占用网络，能够从单视角部分点云推断出完整的3D解剖结构（肿瘤、边缘组织和肾脏）。即使在组织被切割和变形时，这些占用网络仍能保持术中追踪，从而实现自适应规划与执行。该手术平台结合了用于采集表面点云的深度相机、用于电外科切割和基于真空的组织操作的双机械臂，以及用于肿瘤切除的自主控制策略。在开放部分肾切除术设置下的患者来源水凝胶体模中，机器人连续执行了八次自主肿瘤切除，共包含77次电外科切割，所有切割均达到阴性手术切缘，平均绝对切缘误差为1.61 ± 0.48毫米。这项工作首次展示了在体模中进行监督式自主闭环、影像驱动的阴性切缘肿瘤切除的基础。

title: Electromagnetic Micro-Guidewire Control in Large Workspaces
summary: Electromagnetic navigation requires sufficient actuation at clinically relevant distances due to limited magnetic volumes and coil currents. We combine real-time pose feedback with constrained convex optimization, dynamic feedback, and repetitive control to achieve energy-efficient micro-guidewire steering inside realistic anatomical models. Experiments with a clinically oriented, three-coil electromagnetic navigation system and a 0.6 mm-diameter tip magnet demonstrate angular tracking with root-mean-square errors below 0.25 degrees at distances up to 55 cm from the coil cover. Nullspace current redistribution maintains accurate tracking under active 45 A coil-current constraints. Compared with conventional field alignment, we demonstrate that pose-dependent torque-based allocation substantially reduces current demand, with the efficiency benefit retained at a pose-feedback rate of 15 Hz. These results demonstrate how real-time state information and optimization can extend electromagnetic guidewire control toward clinically relevant working distances.
tldr: This paper presents an electromagnetic micro-guidewire steering approach that combines real-time pose feedback, constrained convex optimization, dynamic feedback, and repetitive control to achieve sub-0.25-degree angular tracking at up to 55 cm in realistic anatomical models, while significantly reducing coil current demand via torque-based nullspace allocation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种电磁微型导丝控制方法，结合实时位姿反馈、约束凸优化、动态反馈与重复控制，在真实解剖模型中实现了55厘米工作距离内低于0.25度的角度跟踪，并通过基于力矩的零空间分配显著降低线圈电流需求。
summary_zh: 电磁导航因磁场体积和线圈电流有限，需要在临床相关距离上提供足够的驱动力。我们将实时位姿反馈与约束凸优化、动态反馈及重复控制相结合，在真实解剖模型中实现了高能效的微导丝转向。实验采用面向临床的三线圈电磁导航系统和直径0.6 mm的尖端磁体，在线圈盖板最远55 cm距离处，角度跟踪均方根误差低于0.25度。零空间电流再分配在45 A线圈电流主动约束下仍能保持精确跟踪。与传统磁场对准相比，我们证明基于位姿的力矩分配方法能显著降低电流需求，且在15 Hz位姿反馈频率下仍保持能效优势。这些结果表明，实时状态信息与优化相结合可推动电磁导丝控制向临床相关工作距离延伸。

title: SWIM: Vision-Language-Grounded Soft Whole-Body Interactive Manipulation
summary: Soft and continuum robots enable manipulation through distributed body deformation and contact, yet translating language and visual context into executable whole-body actuation remains a fundamental challenge. We present SWIM, a framework that maps an initial RGB observation and a language instruction to a complete actuation-command sequence. Its vision-language-action (VLA) policy, SWIM-VLA, combines a diffusion action head with Visual Soft Proprioception (VSP) through a shared representation of RGB observations, language instructions, and tendon states. The diffusion head models conditional distributions of expert command chunks, while VSP supervises ordered body-anchor predictions using simulation ground truth, encouraging the representation to retain body geometry when learning from limited demonstrations. Embodied mechanical intelligence supports physical execution of command sequences generated through iterative virtual rollout from evolving simulated observations, with intrinsic compliance providing local contact adaptation without online policy queries. We evaluate SWIM on packing, reaching, and grasping on a planar tendon-driven soft robot, with grasping targets anchored. In simulation, SWIM-VLA achieves success rates of 100\%, 96\%, and 88\%, respectively, outperforming an adapted OpenVLA-OFT baseline and controlled ablations. On hardware, SWIM achieves success rates of 100\%, 80\%, and 75\%, compared with 75\%, 40\%, and 25\% for direct online deployment of the same policy checkpoint.
tldr: Introduces SWIM, a vision-language-action framework for soft whole-body manipulation that maps an RGB observation and language instruction to actuation commands, using a diffusion action head and Visual Soft Proprioception to supervise body-anchor predictions; achieves strong simulation and hardware success rates on a planar tendon-driven soft robot.
tldr_zh: 提出SWIM，一个面向软体全身操作的视觉-语言-动作框架，将RGB观测和语言指令映射为驱动命令，结合扩散动作头与视觉软体本体感知，在平面腱驱动软体机器人上取得了较好的仿真与硬件成功率。
summary_zh: 软体机器人与连续体机器人通过分布式身体形变与接触实现操作，但将语言和视觉上下文转化为可执行的全身驱动命令仍是一项根本性挑战。我们提出SWIM框架，将初始RGB观测和语言指令映射为完整的驱动命令序列。其视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略SWIM-VLA通过RGB观测、语言指令和肌腱状态的共享表征，将扩散动作头与视觉软体本体感知（VSP）相结合。扩散头对专家命令块的条件分布进行建模，而VSP利用仿真真值监督有序身体锚点预测，促使表征在有限演示学习中保留身体几何信息。具身机械智能支持通过对不断演化的仿真观测进行迭代虚拟展开来生成命令序列，并由内在柔顺性提供局部接触自适应，无需在线策略查询。我们在平面肌腱驱动软体机器人上评估了SWIM在打包、到达和抓取任务中的表现，其中抓取目标位置固定。在仿真中，SWIM-VLA的成功率分别达到100%、96%和88%，优于改编的OpenVLA-OFT基线和受控消融实验。在硬件上，SWIM的成功率分别为100%、80%和75%，而同一策略检查点的直接在线部署成功率仅为75%、40%和25%。

title: Differentiable Mesh State Estimation via Factor Graph Inference for Deformable Object Reconstruction
summary: Estimating deformable object states remains a fundamental challenge in robotics and simulation. We propose a novel factor graph-based framework for probabilistic mesh state estimation of deformable objects. The method directly updates a tetrahedral mesh, a rich and physically-grounded representation of an environment, by combining physics priors, noisy sensor measurements, and temporal smoothness constraints within a unified probabilistic formulation. The estimation problem is posed as a nonlinear least-squares optimization and solved using Levenberg-Marquardt. Ex vivo central-airway obstruction experiments and simulations on deforming cube models demonstrate reliable and accurate reconstruction under both rigid motion and deformation, highlighting the potential of this probabilistic approach for principled, measurement-driven mesh state estimation in deformable object reconstruction.
tldr: Proposes a factor-graph-based probabilistic framework for deformable mesh state estimation, directly updating tetrahedral meshes via nonlinear least-squares optimization while combining physics priors, noisy sensor measurements, and temporal smoothness; validated on ex vivo central-airway obstruction and deforming cube simulations.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于因子图的概率框架，通过非线性最小二乘优化直接更新四面体网格，融合物理先验、噪声传感器测量和时间平滑约束，用于可变形物体网格状态估计，并在离体中央气道梗阻实验和立方体变形仿真中验证。
summary_zh: 估计可变形物体状态仍然是机器人和模拟中的一个基本挑战。我们提出了一种新颖的基于因子图的框架，用于可变形物体的概率网格状态估计。该方法通过将物理先验、噪声传感器测量和时间平滑约束统一在一个概率公式中，直接更新四面体网格——一种丰富且基于物理的环境表示。估计问题被构建为非线性最小二乘优化，并使用Levenberg-Marquardt方法求解。离体中央气道阻塞实验以及对变形立方体模型的模拟表明，该框架在刚性运动和变形下均能实现可靠且准确的重建，突显了这种概率方法在可变形物体重建中实现原则性、测量驱动的网格状态估计的潜力。

title: Tendon-Driven Continuum Robot with Modular Stiffness and In-Situ Self Pose Estimation
summary: Continuum robots enable smooth shape morphing and safe interaction in confined environments. However, most existing systems are task-specific and depend on external sensing infrastructure, limiting their adaptability and real-world deployment. This paper presents a self-contained modular continuum robotic platform that combines mechanical reconfigurability with onboard pose estimation. The robot is constructed from interchangeable continuum joints with analytically precomputed stiffness, allowing rapid assembly and direct programming of the robot shape. Proprioceptive sensing is achieved using magnetic sensors and a modular learning-based framework, where a single model is trained per joint and reused across configurations. The system is experimentally validated in real world, demonstrating self-sensing capabilities and adaptation without external tracking.
tldr: This paper presents a modular tendon-driven continuum robot with interchangeable joints of computationally precomputed stiffness, and an onboard magnetic-sensor-based pose estimation framework using a per-joint learned model that can be reused across different configurations, enabling self-contained shape sensing without external tracking.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模块化绳驱连续体机器人，其关节具有可预先计算的刚度，并利用磁传感器和基于每个关节训练、可在不同配置间复用的学习模型实现机载位姿估计，从而在无需外部追踪的情况下完成自感知形状估计。
summary_zh: 连续体机器人能够在受限环境中实现平滑的形状变形和安全交互。然而，现有大多数系统都是针对特定任务设计的，依赖外部感知基础设施，限制了其适应性和实际部署。本文提出了一种自包含的模块化连续体机器人平台，结合了机械可重构性与机载位姿估计。该机器人由可互换的连续体关节构成，这些关节具有解析预计算的刚度，从而支持快速组装和机器人形状的直接编程。本体感知通过磁传感器和基于模块化学习的框架实现，其中每个关节训练一个模型，并在不同配置中复用。该系统在真实世界中进行了实验验证，展示了无需外部跟踪的自感知能力和适应性。

title: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for Precise and Comprehensive Brain Tumor Diagnosis from Preoperative Multimodal Data
summary:
Background Non-invasive presurgical diagnosis of brain tumor types from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is essential but challenging due to overlapping imaging features across tumor types, inter-observer variability, and the extensive training required for expertise. We aimed to develop an MRI-based Artificial Intelligence (AI) model for automatic and reliable brain tumor classification with diagnostic uncertainty quantification and radiology reports generation.
  Methods We developed BrainVLM to classify all 12 World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 brain tumor types. BrainVLM integrates an uncertainty quantification strategy to indicate prediction reliability and a module for generating radiology reports to elucidate the clinical rationale. BrainVLM was trained on multi-modal data (MRI scans, demographics, and radiology reports) from 40,043 individuals. It was validated on 5,211 patients with pathologically confirmed brain tumors, including 3,877 held-out patients from the primary hospital and 1,334 patients from 11 independent hospitals. We further conducted two proof-of-concept studies to validate its clinical utility in AI-clinician workflows: 1) a blinded multi-reader study where 12 neuroradiologists across varying experience levels interpreted 248 retrospective cases with or without AI assistance, and 2) a real-world prospective study in which 1,009 patients were independently and blindly assessed by BrainVLM and radiologists before surgery. Additionally, we demonstrated BrainVLM's utility in preoperative molecular subgroup prediction for adult-type diffuse gliomas, using a multi-center cohort of 632 patients.
tldr: BrainVLM is a vision-language foundation model for brain tumor diagnosis from preoperative MRI and demographic data, classifying all 12 WHO 2021 tumor types, providing uncertainty estimates and radiology reports, and validated in large retrospective/prospective multi-center clinical studies.
tldr_zh: BrainVLM 是一个基于视觉-语言的医学基础模型，利用术前MRI和临床数据对12种WHO 2021脑肿瘤类型进行分类，并输出不确定性估计和放射学报告；在大规模回顾性及前瞻性多中心临床研究中得到验证。
summary_zh:
摘要
背景：基于磁共振成像（MRI）的脑肿瘤类型无创术前诊断至关重要，但由于不同肿瘤类型间影像特征重叠、观察者间差异以及专业知识培训周期长，这一任务具有挑战性。我们旨在开发一种基于MRI的人工智能（AI）模型，用于自动、可靠的脑肿瘤分类，并具备诊断不确定性量化及放射学报告生成功能。
方法：我们开发了BrainVLM模型，用于分类世界卫生组织（WHO）2021年分类中全部12种脑肿瘤类型。BrainVLM整合了不确定性量化策略以提示预测可靠性，并包含一个放射学报告生成模块以阐明临床依据。BrainVLM基于来自40,043名个体的多模态数据（MRI扫描、人口统计学信息及放射学报告）进行训练，并在5,211例经病理确诊的脑肿瘤患者上完成验证，其中包括主要医院3,877例保留患者和11家独立医院的1,334例患者。我们进一步开展了两项概念验证研究，以验证其在AI-临床医生工作流程中的临床实用性：1）一项盲法多阅片者研究，12名不同经验水平的神经放射科医生在有无AI辅助下解读248例回顾性病例；2）一项真实世界前瞻性研究，1,009例患者在术前由BrainVLM和放射科医生独立、盲法评估。此外，我们使用一个包含632例患者的多中心队列，证明了BrainVLM在成人型弥漫性胶质瘤术前分子亚型预测中的实用性。

title: CLEAR: Cross-Source Evidence Adjudication for Large Language Models in Medicine
summary: Medical knowledge evolves continuously, whereas the parametric knowledge encoded in large language models (LLMs) is fixed at training time. External retrieval, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), can provide access to newly available evidence, but retrieved information may be irrelevant, incomplete, or conflicting. As a result, external retrieval can in turn degrade the factual accuracy and evidence grounding of LLM outputs. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{CLEAR}, an agentic framework for cross-source evidence adjudication in LLMs in medicine. CLEAR independently generates candidate answers from three complementary pathways---parametric knowledge, locally curated corpora, and dynamically retrieved evidence---reflecting three common sources of information available to LLMs. An aggregation verifier jointly evaluates the candidates, supporting evidence, provenance, and source-quality information to identify agreement and conflict across sources. An adjudication module then determines whether the current conclusion should be preserved or revised through complementary override-guard and challenge-audit mechanisms, while unresolved conflicts trigger targeted follow-up search and re-adjudication.
tldr: CLEAR is an agentic framework for medical LLMs that generates candidate answers from three complementary sources—parametric knowledge, local corpora, and retrieved evidence—and adjudicates conflicts among them using verifiers, override-guard/challenge-audit mechanisms, and targeted follow-up search to improve factual accuracy and evidence grounding.
tldr_zh: CLEAR 是一个面向医学大语言模型的智能体框架，通过从参数知识、本地语料库和动态检索证据三条互补路径生成候选答案，并利用验证器、覆盖保护/挑战审计机制以及定向补充搜索来裁决跨来源冲突，从而提升事实准确性与证据支撑。
summary_zh: 医学知识持续演进，而大型语言模型（LLM）中编码的参数化知识在训练时即已固定。外部检索，包括检索增强生成（RAG），能够提供对新近可用证据的访问，但检索到的信息可能不相关、不完整或相互冲突。因此，外部检索反而可能降低LLM输出的事实准确性和证据依据。为应对这一挑战，我们提出\textbf{CLEAR}，一个面向医学领域LLM的跨来源证据裁决智能体框架。CLEAR通过三条互补路径独立生成候选答案——参数化知识、本地精选语料库和动态检索证据——反映LLM可获得的三种常见信息来源。一个聚合验证器联合评估候选答案、支持证据、来源出处和来源质量信息，以识别跨来源的一致性与冲突。随后，一个裁决模块通过互补的覆盖-守护和质疑-审计机制，决定当前结论应予以保留还是修订，同时未解决的冲突会触发针对性的后续搜索和重新裁决。

title: A multimodal large language model for evidence-based autism spectrum disorder screening
summary: The clinical management of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) faces a bottleneck in early screening, mainly because trained specialists are scarce and conventional assessment tools are subjective. Here, we introduce ASDchat, a multimodal large language model designed for evidence-based ASD screening, which takes video, audio, and dialogue as input. ASDchat adopts a dual-branch architecture, where the decision branch generates screening probabilities and the evidence branch generates traceable, timestamped behavioral evidence aligned with standardized clinical criteria (ADOS-2). The model was trained and evaluated on a dataset of 1,035 participants from 27 sites in China, which covered typically developing (TD) children, children with ASD, and children with other disorders. For ASD versus TD, ASDchat reached an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.953 $\pm$ 0.021. On 9 held-out sites that were not used for training, the mean AUC was 0.932. Furthermore, unsupervised clustering of the behavioral dimensions split the ASD cases into six subtypes with different phenotypic profiles, and ASDchat suggests an intervention for each subtype. ASDchat provides a feasible path for large-scale, evidence-based early ASD screening in clinical practice.
tldr: ASDchat is a multimodal large language model for autism spectrum disorder screening that takes video, audio, and dialogue as input, uses a dual-branch architecture to output both screening probabilities and timestamped behavioral evidence aligned with clinical ADOS-2 criteria, and was validated on a multi-site Chinese dataset with high AUC and identified ASD subtypes.
tldr_zh: ASDchat是一种用于自闭症谱系障碍筛查的多模态大语言模型，输入视频、音频和对话，通过双分支结构同时输出筛查概率和符合ADOS-2临床标准的时间戳行为证据，并在多中心数据集上取得较高AUC，且识别出不同ASD亚型。
summary_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的临床管理在早期筛查方面面临瓶颈，主要原因是训练有素的专业人员稀缺，且传统评估工具具有主观性。在此，我们介绍了ASDchat，一种用于循证ASD筛查的多模态大语言模型，其输入为视频、音频和对话。ASDchat采用双分支架构，其中决策分支生成筛查概率，证据分支生成可追溯、带时间戳且符合标准化临床标准（ADOS-2）的行为证据。该模型在来自中国27个中心、共1035名参与者的数据集上进行了训练和评估，该数据集涵盖典型发育（TD）儿童、ASD儿童以及其他障碍儿童。对于ASD与TD的区分，ASDchat的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）达到0.953±0.021。在未参与训练的9个保留中心上，平均AUC为0.932。此外，对行为维度进行无监督聚类，将ASD病例分为六种具有不同表型特征的亚型，ASDchat为每种亚型提出了干预建议。ASDchat为临床实践中大规模、循证的ASD早期筛查提供了一条可行路径。

title: TEDi: Temporal Memory-Enhanced and Denoising Transformer for Surgical Instrument Segmentation
summary: Query-based segmentation methods have shown promising potential for surgical instrument segmentation and recognition, which is essential for scene understanding and downstream tasks in computer assisted surgery. However, most existing approaches predominantly rely on per-frame predictions and overlook cross-frame temporal priors as well as temporal-consistency constraints. This limitation often leads to unstable query representations and suboptimal category recognition. In this paper, we propose TEDi, a Temporal memory-Enhanced and Denoising transformer for surgical instrument segmentation that addresses these is sues through Memory Search Enhancement and Temporal Consistency Denoising. The former introduces a query-level memory bank and a memory search enhancement encoder to retrieve discriminative representations from historical frames, enriching current-frame features. The latter constructs a temporally consistent reference as a cross-frame semantic anchor to suppress temporally unstable predictions and promote semantic coherence across frames. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets, EndoVis 2017 and EndoVis 2018, demonstrate that TEDi consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, highlighting its potential to further advance computer-assisted surgery. Our code is available at github.com/argon-xixi/TEDi.
tldr: TEDi is a temporal memory-enhanced and denoising transformer for surgical instrument segmentation that uses a query-level memory bank and temporal consistency denoising to exploit cross-frame information, achieving state-of-the-art results on EndoVis 2017 and EndoVis 2018.
tldr_zh: TEDi是一种用于手术器械分割的时间记忆增强与去噪Transformer，通过查询级记忆库和时序一致性去噪利用跨帧信息，在EndoVis 2017和EndoVis 2018上取得了最先进性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：基于查询的分割方法在手术器械分割与识别方面展现出巨大潜力，这对于计算机辅助手术中的场景理解和下游任务至关重要。然而，现有方法大多主要依赖逐帧预测，忽略了跨帧时间先验以及时间一致性约束。这一局限常导致查询表示不稳定以及类别识别欠佳。本文提出TEDi——一种用于手术器械分割的时间记忆增强与去噪Transformer，通过记忆搜索增强和时间一致性去噪来解决上述问题。前者引入查询级记忆库和记忆搜索增强编码器，从历史帧中检索判别性表示，以丰富当前帧特征。后者构建时间一致性参考作为跨帧语义锚点，以抑制时间不稳定的预测，并促进帧间语义连贯性。在EndoVis 2017和EndoVis 2018两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TEDi持续优于最先进方法，凸显了其进一步推动计算机辅助手术发展的潜力。我们的代码可在 github.com/argon-xixi/TEDi 获取。

title: PanoGS-SLAM: Panoramic 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary: Real-time dense SLAM is a core capability for robotics applications that require robust localization and high- quality mapping in dynamic or fast-changing environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based SLAM methods have shown promising performance, but most are designed for narrow-FoV pinhole cameras, where limited angular coverage weakens pose observability and often leads to unstable photo- metric optimization under rapid motion and large viewpoint changes. We present PanoGS-SLAM, the first panoramic dense SLAM system built on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method per- forms differentiable rendering and pose optimization directly in the spherical domain, enabling omnidirectional photometric constraints for more stable tracking. To improve geometric consistency and robustness, we introduce (1) a sphere-consistent photometric loss that compensates for the area distortion of equirectangular projection, and (2) a depth-guided Gaussian initialization strategy that stabilizes incremental mapping in newly observed regions. Extensive experiments on both real and synthetic panoramic benchmarks (PALVIO and SynPano) show that PanoGS-SLAM consistently outperforms geometric and GS-based baselines in tracking accuracy and rendering quality, while achieving fast front-end convergence and real-time perfor- mance. In addition, controlled field-of-view experiments reveal a clear monotonic improvement in optimization conditioning and convergence stability as angular coverage increases, high- lighting the fundamental role of sensing geometry in shaping the optimization landscape of differentiable Gaussian-based SLAM. The source code will be made publicly available.
tldr: PanoGS-SLAM introduces the first panoramic dense SLAM system based on 3D Gaussian Splatting, using spherical-domain differentiable rendering, a sphere-consistent photometric loss, and depth-guided Gaussian initialization to improve tracking accuracy and mapping quality under wide field-of-view conditions.
tldr_zh: PanoGS-SLAM 提出了首个基于三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）的全景稠密SLAM系统，通过在球面域进行可微渲染、引入球面一致光度损失和深度引导的高斯初始化，提升了宽视场下的跟踪精度和建图质量。
summary_zh: 实时密集SLAM是机器人应用中的核心能力，这些应用需要在动态或快速变化的环境中实现稳健的定位和高质量建图。近年基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的SLAM方法展现出良好的性能，但大多数方法针对窄视场针孔相机设计，其有限的角覆盖范围削弱了位姿可观测性，在快速运动和大视角变化下常导致光度优化不稳定。我们提出PanoGS-SLAM，这是首个基于3D高斯泼溅的全景密集SLAM系统。我们的方法直接在球面域进行可微渲染和位姿优化，利用全向光度约束实现更稳定的跟踪。为提升几何一致性和鲁棒性，我们引入（1）一种球面一致的光度损失，用于补偿等距柱状投影的面积畸变，以及（2）一种深度引导的高斯初始化策略，用于稳定新观测区域的增量建图。在真实与合成全景基准（PALVIO和SynPano）上的大量实验表明，PanoGS-SLAM在跟踪精度和渲染质量上 consistently 优于基于几何和基于GS的基线方法，同时实现快速前端收敛和实时性能。此外，受控视场实验揭示，随着角覆盖范围增加，优化条件和收敛稳定性呈现明显的单调改善，凸显了传感几何在塑造可微高斯SLAM优化景观中的基础性作用。源代码将公开发布。
